dct_title_s: Damage Assessment in A'zaz City, Aleppo Governorate, Syria as of 9 February 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code EQ20230206SYR, GDACS Id: 1357372** This map illustrates the Potentially damaged structures/buildings affected by the 6th of February 2023 earthquake in Azaz City (Aleppo governorate) in Syria as detected from a Pleiades very high-resolution satellite image acquired on 9 February 2023. Within the analyzed area of about 30km2, UNOSAT identified 18 damaged structures and 73 potentially damaged. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
